metadata.source: Kawasaki.com official specs (2013 US model) + bikez.com + Wikipedia (claimed power/torque); Z300 service manual firing order 1-2 (180-degree crank)
metadata.notes: Factory: 296 cc liquid-cooled DOHC 8-valve parallel twin, 62.0 x 49.0 mm, compression 10.6:1, DFI with dual 32 mm throttle bodies, 29 kW (39 hp) @ 11,000 rpm, 27 Nm @ 10,000 rpm claimed, six-speed, chain, assist/slipper clutch, ABS option, 17.0 L fuel, 172 kg wet curb, wheelbase 1405 mm, 110/70-17 / 140/70-17 tyres. Firing order 1-2 = 180-degree crank (Z300 owner's manual; kawasakininja300.com). Estimates (no factory source found): redline ~12,750 rpm (ECU cut commonly cited), primary drive 1.857, final drive 2.800 (42/15), gearbox ratios, rod ratio 2.45, valve sizes 27.0/24.0 mm, cam timing, flywheel 2.0 kg @ 80 mm, idle 1,300 rpm. Not yet calibrated to a dyno reference.
